title: Migrate to PostGIS: convert JSON geometry columns and distance logic
description:
Prerequisite for matching/measuring question types (see design/matching-measuring-questions.md).

Scope:
- Docker image: postgres:17 → postgis/postgis:17-3.5
- Add geoalchemy2 dependency (uv add geoalchemy2)
- Convert existing JSON geometry columns to PostGIS geometry/geography types:
  - GameMap.boundary (GeoJSON Polygon → geometry)
  - Route.shape (GeoJSON LineString → geometry)
  - Stop.coordinates (GeoJSON Point → geometry)
  - LocationUpdate.coordinates (GeoJSON Point → geography)
  - Question.seeker_location_start/end, hider_location (GeoJSON Point → geography)
  - District boundaries (JSON → geometry)
- Add spatial indexes on geometry columns
- Update geo.py: optionally replace haversine with ST_Distance for point-to-point
- Update queries that read/write geometry to use GeoAlchemy2 types
- Update test fixtures (in-memory SQLite won't support PostGIS — need test strategy)
- Drop SQLite support for local dev (Docker becomes the primary dev path)
- Verify all existing tests pass with PostgreSQL/PostGIS
close_reason: Migrated to geoalchemy2 with ShapelyGeometry columns, PostGIS for Docker, SpatiaLite for local/tests

title: Opportunistic location updates on API actions
description:
Many API actions are made by players whose current location is known to the client. Rather than relying solely on the dedicated POST /games/{game_id}/location endpoint, we should accept an optional location field on relevant requests and treat it as an implicit location update.

Candidate endpoints:
- POST /games/{game_id}/questions (seeker asking a question — already needs seeker location)
- POST /games/{game_id}/questions/{id}/lock-in (seeker locking in thermometer — uses latest location)
- POST /games/{game_id}/questions/{id}/answer (hider answering — snapshots hider location)

Benefits:
- Reduces location staleness for critical game actions
- Fewer dedicated location report round-trips needed
- More accurate question answers since location is fresh at the moment of action

Implementation:
- Add optional 'coordinates' (GeoJSON Point) + 'timestamp' fields to relevant request schemas
- When present, create a LocationUpdate before processing the main action
- Use the fresh location instead of querying the latest stored one
- Backward compatible: field is optional, existing behavior unchanged if omitted
